challenge.method: Compared the generated text's section 4 layout with the publisher's and checked whether the citation could identify BY-NC-ND.
challenge.results: The layout differs. The source path is /by-nc/2.0/legalcode and section 3(b) in both texts says ‘to create and reproduce Derivative Works’. The NC-ND alternative has a different path and grant text.

limitations: The finding covers documentary correspondence. In particular, SPDX runs the Webcasting Rights passage into section 4(d)(ii), while the publisher sets it in a separate list item. Legal equivalence, downstream grants and redistribution rights remain outside scope.
